name: mtc-week5-demo
description: TypeScript demo files for class. The TypeScript version is pinned so `npx tsc` resolves this exact compiler instead of whatever npm's `latest` tag points to. `type: module` matches the `--module ES2020` compile flag — without it, `node store-typed.js` prints a spurious MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning before the real output.
